aboutMe.intro: For five years I drove trains through regional transit. A job where focus, responsibility, and calm decisions under pressure are non-negotiable. Then I threw the lever: out of the cab and into the code. Not a hobby and not a side project, but a complete fresh start with no safety net. It was the best decision of my working life.
aboutMe.flexibleLocation: I'm strongest where an application has to be thought through completely, from the database to the interface. Backend logic, data models, authentication, frontend, and deployment. I command the whole picture, not just a slice of it. Others specialize in one corner. I build the entire house.
aboutMe.openMinded: I learn faster than most. I picked up the bulk of my stack not in a course, but on real projects, under real requirements and with real consequences. A new language or a new framework isn't a risk for me, it's routine. Give me a week and I deliver.
aboutMe.creativeProblemSolving: I think in systems, not in tickets. Before I build, I understand why something should work a certain way and how it will feel a year from now. My architecture decisions are made deliberately and documented so that the person after me never has to guess. Care isn't something you retrofit later. With me, it's built in from the start.

skillset.description: I'm technically at home in the TypeScript ecosystem, with Vue, Nuxt, and Angular on the frontend, plus PostgreSQL, containerized backends with Docker, and modern auth flows via OAuth 2.0 and Microsoft Entra ID. New tools keep coming. I don't stand still, I move the field with me.
skillset.contactText: Let's talk about it. I value feedback over applause, and a new challenge is exactly my thing.
skillset.interest: These technologies particularly interest me at the moment

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: A selection of my work. Interact with the projects directly and try them out yourself.

join.description: A task manager built on the Kanban principle. Create and organize tasks via drag-and-drop, assign users and categories. Thought through from the logic to the interface.

sharky.description: A jump-and-run game built on a clean object-oriented approach. Help Sharkie collect coins and poison bottles to take on the killer whale.

martin_rs.description: A client project from A to Z. I migrated the website to a new domain, rebuilt it on the basis of a WordPress template, and extended it with a contact form and Google reCAPTCHA, for more security and better user interaction.

rc_car.description: A remote-controlled RC car with a Raspberry Pi 5 as its control center, operable worldwide via a web app over mobile networks. The live stream from the onboard camera and precise control via a PS4 controller enable a real-time driving experience from any location. Hardware, network, and software from a single source.

pokedex.description: Built on the PokéAPI. A library that cleanly fetches, prepares, and catalogs Pokémon information.

dabubble.description: DABubble is a modern chat app for simple communication and efficient collaboration, with channels, direct messages, and real-time reactions.

quotes.headline: References from clients and colleagues
quotes.quote_1: Mike was a pleasant teammate who always listened attentively and provided valuable input. His proactive approach was particularly impressive.
quotes.quote_2: Mike's 2D game Sharkie stands out with its smooth gameplay and appealing visuals. It was a lot of fun to test.
quotes.quote_3: The animations in Mike's project Join were entertaining and creative. The option to edit tasks without drag-and-drop was a practical alternative.
quotes.quote_4: Mike was an extremely reliable member of our project. He proactively took on responsibility, for example for version control of the main branch, and always completed his tasks satisfactorily within the agreed timeframe.
quotes.quote_5: Mike used the creative freedom he was given with great commitment and also contributed new ideas. Together, we were able to reach the ideal result. He implemented change requests, even afterwards, particularly quickly and was always involved with great enthusiasm. Thank you for this great project!
